regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing, non-dominant narrative rotation: AI Infrastructure leads with a modest score (1.56) and mediocre breadth (0.125), while a broad Energy Complex sits close behind (margin 0.185) with far better breadth (0.636). The only validated leg — the absolute-trend gate — is helping on this market's history, so trend discipline is worth honoring; everything else is a focus lens, not alpha.
emerging_watch: Watching whether AI Infrastructure's leadership handoff to US Energy Complex CONFIRMS: the observable condition to retire this watch is breadth of AI Infrastructure recovering above 0.30 AND the rotation margin (currently 0.185) widening back above 0.4 for 5 consecutive sessions — if that happens, the energy-challenger thesis is premature. Conversely, the handoff confirms if Energy Complex overtakes AI Infrastructure in score while both stay eligible and Energy breadth holds above 0.5.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy is the only top-tier theme combining eligibility, strong durability (0.62), and broad participation (breadth 0.636) — the breadth and trend-health legs suggest this is a cohesive, multi-name move rather than a single-stock carry. It is not crowded (crowding_z 0.93, below threshold), and it sits as the confirmed challenger to AI Infrastructure with the rotation margin narrowing (0.185). Unlike the AI leader, its absolute-trend gate is intact and its breadth implies staying power rather than attention spike.
evidence: breadth 0.636 — strongest breadth in the top 5
rotation.challenger with narrowing margin 0.185 vs AI Infra
theses.dissent: Energy is a macro-cyclical; if growth expectations roll over or rates rise sharply, the complex mean-reverts fast. Its crowding_z is higher than any non-crowded peer, suggesting fast-money interest is already building, and an inflow/attention spike would mark a local top rather than confirm strength.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure ranks #1 (score 1.56) but carries the weakest breadth (0.125) of the leading themes — leadership is extremely concentrated, a classic late-stage attention structure. Its durability (0.5) is only at threshold and hurst is mixed, while the rotation breadth is narrowing (0.45 frac, 'narrowing' view). The detector flags this as a one-name carry, not a broad theme; the only validated risk-control leg says it remains eligible, but the focus-lens legs give no stay-power evidence.
evidence: breadth 0.125 — lowest of any top-10 theme
theses.dissent: The AI Infrastructure leader is not crowded (crowding_z 0.15) and remains eligible — if new money rotates in and breadth expands above ~0.3, this becomes a durable leadership move and 'avoid' is wrong. Fading the leader outright is the documented failure mode.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity ranks #3 (score 1.192) and is trend-consistent, but it is the only crowded theme in the top tier (crowding_z 1.61, crowded=true). Crowding is a size-down caution, not a fade — but combined with its elevated crowding and the guardrails' note that attention/inflow spikes mark tops, the risk-reward for adding here is poor. The absolute-trend gate keeps it eligible, so a modest underweight rather than outright avoid is the honest read.
theses.dissent: Cybersecurity has the strongest durability (0.75) and a genuine trend (hurst 'trend'), with decent breadth (0.6). The crowding flag has no basket-level forward edge per the backtest verdict — it only cautions, never predicts drawdown. An underweight could easily lag if the secular security spend narrative continues.
